preconditions.description: The number of main courses (k) is between 1 and the total number of courses (n), inclusive.
Main course numbers are within the range of total course numbers.
The number of dependencies for each course (t_i) is between 0 and n-1, inclusive.
The total number of dependencies across all courses does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: Output is -1 if there is no way to get a specialty.
Output m is the minimum number of courses to pass to get a specialty.

postconditions.expression: all(course in output_order for course in main_courses)
postconditions.description: All main courses are included in the output order.

postconditions.expression: all(course_order_is_valid(output_order, course, dependencies) for course, dependencies in enumerate(course_dependencies, start=1))
postconditions.description: The output order respects the dependencies of each course.

invariants.description: The list of main courses has exactly k elements.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= course <= n for course in main_courses)
invariants.description: All main course numbers are within the range of total course numbers.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= dependencies.get(course, 0) <= n - 1 for course, dependencies in enumerate(course_dependencies, start=1))
invariants.description: Each course's dependencies are within the valid range.

invariants.expression: all(course not in dependencies for course, dependencies in enumerate(course_dependencies, start=1) if dependencies)

invariants.description: The total number of dependencies across all courses does not exceed 10^5.
